results.content:
Hi everyone, I'm Marco. I make small iPhone apps on my own. Badgey turns your iPhone into a name badge. Clip the phone to a lanyard and turn it upside down: the badge turns round to face the people in front of you and swings a little as you walk. Slide it top first into a chest pocket and it shrinks to a strip, so your name shows above the edge. The pocket check uses the front camera for a few seconds while the phone is upside down. A small model on the phone decides, and the frames are never stored. You can keep several badges (work, a conference, a meetup), add a link that turns into a QR code on the back, and choose a design: Classic, Office, Event, Minimal or Live, which moves. results.title: ‎Badgey App - App Store
results.content:
New: Luxury, liquid gold flowing through black lacquer with diamond glints. A Live animation for the badge that walks in first.
Badgey turns your iPhone into a name badge. Add your photo, name and role, pick a design, then wear it: on a lanyard or in your chest pocket, your badge turns to face the people you meet.
WEAR IT ON A LANYARD
Clip your phone to a lanyard and turn it upside down. Badgey flips your badge the right way round for everyone in front of you and drops in a lanyard to match. As you walk, turn and lean, the badge swings with you, just like a real one. Prefer it still? Turn Swing off.
OR IN YOUR POCKET
Slide your phone into a chest pocket, top first. Badgey notices and shrinks your badge to a bright strip, so your name stays on show above the pocket's edge. [...] # Badgey

Your name badge, on your phone

Free · In‑App Purchases [...] A BADGE FOR EVERY OCCASION
Keep a badge for work, one for the conference you're speaking at and one for the meetup you're volunteering at. Swipe between them and wear whichever fits the day.
SHARE IN A SCAN
Add a link to your website, portfolio or profile and your badge flips over to a QR code anyone can scan with their camera.
FREE TO START
Badgey is free with one badge, the Classic and Live designs and the Bloom animation. Badgey Pro is a one-time purchase, shared with your family, that unlocks more badges, every design, the Live animations, backgrounds and type styles. Only want one design or animation? Buy it on its own. Luxury is sold on its own.
THOUGHTFUL BY DESIGN
• The screen stays awake while you wear your badge
• No account, no ads, no subscription
• Works on iPhone and iPad
